notes: Adapted from the fork's shared mage default (ui/mage/apls/p1.apl.json), which is the Fire branch of a package that falls back to Frostbolt for non-Fire specs. Its Fireball and Frostbolt references were stale ranks (10) where the build's current top ranks are 12 (25306) and 11 (25304) respectively; Frostbolt is dropped entirely since this file is Fire-specific and never falls back to it. Fire Blast is added on cooldown as a free extra nuke per community guides, which the shared preset omitted. Fix round 1 had re-gated the Improved Scorch stack check from the client's Fire Vulnerability id (22959) to 12873, the id sim/core/debuffs.go's ImprovedScorchAura hardcodes -- on the theory that 12873 was at least an id the engine registers. Fix round 3: it is not one the mage's own Scorch casts ever produce. sim/core/debuffs.go creates that aura only when the raid's Improved Scorch debuff toggle is turned on from outside this character (a periodic application of its own); nothing in sim/mage triggers it. So the stack-gated Scorch upkeep line and the stack-gated Combustion pop were both reading a condition that can never resolve true under any mage-only rotation, which the nil-condition-reads-as-true behaviour of APLAction.IsReady turned into 'cast Scorch on every global, never reach Fireball or Combustion' -- the exact bug fix round 1 set out to remove, one id further along. There is no engine-castable way today for a mage's own APL to gate on Improved Scorch stacks, so the Scorch upkeep line is dropped outright (engine follow-up: model the mage's own Scorch applying the debuff, tracked in the engine ledger) and Combustion becomes an unconditional burst cooldown, the same shape Arcane Power and Presence of Mind use in mage-arcane -- it is talent-gated and unregistered under this bare build regardless (see smokeBuildWarnings), so the cooldown line documents intent rather than firing here. Fireball, at the current top rank, is now the sole filler. Every other rank named here is checked against the spellconst of the newest client build in builds/.

priorityList.notes: Combustion on cooldown, as a straight burst cooldown rather than gated on Improved Scorch stacks. Fix round 3: the engine only creates the Improved Scorch debuff aura (12873) from the raid's own debuff toggle, never from this mage's Scorch casts, so a stack gate can never resolve true here (engine follow-up: model the mage's own Scorch applying the debuff). Talent-gated and unregistered under this bare smoke build regardless (see smokeBuildWarnings) -- this line documents intent, the same shape Arcane Power and Presence of Mind use in mage-arcane.
Fire Blast on cooldown as a free extra nuke that does not compete with Fireball for a global.

Fireball is the primary filler. Fix round 3: Scorch is no longer cast at all -- with no working Improved Scorch stack gate available (see above), an unconditional Scorch line would simply win every global ahead of Fireball, the same defect fix round 1 tried and failed to remove.
